requirements.statement: The system shall display a list of ceramic products with name, representative image, price, and short description.

criteria.must: The product list displays each product's name
The product list displays each product's representative image
The product list displays each product's price
The product list displays each product's short description

requirements.statement: The system shall allow browsing products by category and by collection/tag.

criteria.must: Selecting a category filters the product list to that category
Selecting a collection/tag filters the product list to that collection/tag

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a product detail page showing full description, materials/care instructions, dimensions, multiple images, price, available variants, and stock status.

criteria.must: The product detail page shows the full description
The product detail page shows materials/care instructions
The product detail page shows dimensions
The product detail page shows more than one image when available
The product detail page shows the price
The product detail page shows selectable variants (e.g. glaze color, size)
The product detail page shows the current stock status

requirements.statement: The system shall support full-text search over product name and description.

criteria.must: Searching a term matching a product's name returns that product
Searching a term matching a product's description returns that product

requirements.statement: The system shall allow sorting/filtering results (e.g., by price, newest, category).

criteria.must: The shopper can sort the product list by price
The shopper can sort the product list by newest

requirements.statement: The system shall mark a product or variant as 'Sold Out' when its stock count is zero and shall prevent adding sold-out items to the cart.

criteria.must: A product/variant with zero stock is visibly labeled 'Sold Out'
Adding a sold-out product/variant to the cart is prevented

requirements.statement: The system shall support marking a product as a one-of-a-kind piece that is automatically delisted from the catalog once purchased.

criteria.must: A product can be marked as one-of-a-kind
A one-of-a-kind product is automatically delisted from the catalog immediately after it is purchased

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a shopper to add a product (with selected variant) and quantity to a cart.

criteria.must: A shopper can add a selected variant and quantity of a product to the cart

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a shopper to view, update quantities in, and remove items from the cart.

criteria.must: A shopper can view the current contents of their cart
A shopper can update the quantity of an item in the cart
A shopper can remove an item from the cart

requirements.statement: The system shall persist the guest cart across pages within the same session/browser, and persist it to the shopper's account when signed in across devices/sessions.

criteria.must: A guest's cart persists when navigating between pages in the same browser session
A signed-in shopper's cart persists across sessions/devices

requirements.statement: The system shall prevent the cart from holding more units of a variant than are currently in stock, re-validating stock at checkout time.

criteria.must: The cart cannot hold more units of a variant than are currently in stock
Stock is re-validated at checkout time before payment

requirements.statement: The system shall display a running subtotal (before shipping and tax) as the cart changes.

criteria.must: The cart subtotal updates immediately when items or quantities change

requirements.statement: The system shall allow checkout as a guest or, if signed in, using saved details.

criteria.must: A shopper can complete checkout without creating an account
A signed-in shopper can complete checkout using previously saved details

requirements.statement: The system shall collect a shipping address, contact email, and optionally a phone number.

criteria.must: Checkout requires a shipping address
Checkout requires a contact email
Checkout accepts an optional phone number without requiring it

requirements.statement: The system shall apply a flat-rate shipping fee based on configurable rules; no real-time carrier rate lookup is required.

criteria.must: A flat-rate (or threshold-based free) shipping fee is applied and shown at checkout

requirements.statement: The system shall calculate and display applicable sales tax based on the shipping destination.

criteria.must: Sales tax is calculated based on the shipping destination and displayed before payment

requirements.statement: The system shall process payment through a third-party payment gateway supporting major credit/debit cards.

criteria.must: A checkout with a valid card is charged successfully through the payment gateway

requirements.statement: The system shall re-validate stock availability and current prices immediately before charging payment, and shall reject/adjust the order if an item became unavailable.

criteria.must: An item that became unavailable between add-to-cart and payment causes the order to be rejected or adjusted rather than silently charged

requirements.statement: On successful payment, the system shall create an order record, decrement stock for each purchased variant, and display an order confirmation with an order number.

criteria.must: A successful payment creates an order record
A successful payment decrements stock for each purchased variant
The shopper sees an order confirmation screen displaying an order number

requirements.statement: The system shall send an order confirmation email to the shopper after successful checkout.

criteria.must: An order confirmation email is sent to the shopper after successful checkout

requirements.statement: If payment fails, the system shall show a clear error and leave the cart intact so the shopper can retry.

criteria.must: A failed payment displays a clear error message to the shopper
A failed payment leaves the cart contents intact for retry

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a shopper to register an account with email and password (or equivalent), and to sign in/out.

criteria.must: A shopper can register a new account
A registered shopper can sign in
A signed-in shopper can sign out

requirements.statement: A signed-in shopper shall be able to view their past orders and each order's status.

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper can view a list of their past orders
Each past order shows its current status

requirements.statement: A signed-in shopper shall be able to save one or more shipping addresses for reuse at checkout.

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper can save a shipping address
A saved address can be selected/reused at checkout

requirements.statement: Guest checkout shall never require account creation and shall optionally offer to create an account from the details already entered.

criteria.must: Guest checkout completes successfully without requiring account creation
Guest checkout offers an option to create an account from the entered details

requirements.statement: The system shall let an admin view a list of orders with filtering by status.

criteria.must: An admin can view a list of all orders
An admin can filter the order list by status

requirements.statement: The system shall let an admin view full order detail: items, customer/shipping info, payment status, and history of status changes.

criteria.must: The order detail view shows the order's items
The order detail view shows customer and shipping information
The order detail view shows the payment status
The order detail view shows the history of status changes

requirements.statement: The system shall let an admin update an order's fulfillment status and optionally attach a shipment tracking number, triggering a shopper notification email.

criteria.must: An admin can update an order's fulfillment status
An admin can attach a shipment tracking number to an order
Updating fulfillment status triggers a shopper notification email

requirements.statement: The system shall let an admin issue a refund or cancel an order, reflecting this in order status and, where applicable, restoring stock.

criteria.must: An admin can cancel an order
An admin can issue a refund for an order
Canceling/refunding an order restores stock for the affected variants where applicable

requirements.statement: The system shall let an admin create, edit, and retire (unpublish) products, including name, description, category, images, price, and variants.

criteria.must: An admin can create a new product with name, description, category, images, price, and variants
An admin can edit an existing product's fields
An admin can retire (unpublish) a product so it no longer appears in the storefront catalog

requirements.statement: The system shall let an admin set and adjust the stock count for each product/variant.

criteria.must: An admin can set the stock count for a product/variant
An admin can adjust (increase or decrease) the stock count for a product/variant

requirements.statement: The system shall let an admin mark a product as featured or as a one-of-a-kind piece.

criteria.must: An admin can mark a product as featured
An admin can mark a product as one-of-a-kind

requirements.statement: The system shall restrict catalog and order management actions to authenticated admin users only.

criteria.must: An unauthenticated request to a catalog or order management action is rejected
An authenticated non-admin request to a catalog or order management action is rejected

requirements.statement: Payment card data shall never be stored or handled directly by the application; it shall be tokenized/processed entirely through the payment gateway.

criteria.must: Raw card numbers are never persisted in the application's own data store

requirements.statement: Admin functionality shall require authentication and shall not be reachable by unauthenticated or non-admin users.

criteria.must: The admin console requires sign-in before any admin functionality is reachable

requirements.statement: Shopper personal data shall be stored securely and transmitted only over encrypted connections (TLS).

criteria.must: The storefront and admin console are served exclusively over HTTPS/TLS

requirements.statement: Catalog listing and product detail pages shall load within 2 seconds under normal load.

criteria.must: The catalog listing page loads within 2 seconds under normal load
A product detail page loads within 2 seconds under normal load

requirements.statement: Stock decrements must be atomic/consistent so that concurrent purchases cannot oversell a limited or one-of-a-kind item.

criteria.must: Two concurrent purchase attempts for the last unit of a variant result in exactly one succeeding and one being rejected/adjusted

requirements.statement: The storefront shall be usable on both desktop and mobile browsers (responsive design).

criteria.must: The storefront's catalog, cart, and checkout flows are usable on a mobile-width viewport

requirements.statement: Changes to order status and stock adjustments made by admins shall be recorded with a timestamp and the acting admin.

criteria.must: An order status change records a timestamp and the acting admin
A stock adjustment records a timestamp and the acting admin
